name: healthcare-microservices-platform
description: Two independent FastAPI microservices (Patient Records and Appointments) with separate PostgreSQL databases, communicating via REST for sync checks and Redis pub/sub for async notifications. Includes a Streamlit demo UI and full Docker Compose setup.

requirements.text: It covers staff login/registration, a dashboard with KPIs and charts, a searchable patient directory with a registration form, an appointment list with cancellation, and a booking form that exercises the real Appointment → Patient Records validation flow (including the 503 path if Patient Records is down).
Every account has a role of either staff or admin, set at registration and embedded in the JWT the person receives at login.
